project.name: Vidulum Wealth
project.description:
What the owner holds, what they trade, what it was worth and what is at risk. The six modules that used to be one artifact called vidulum-wealth, split across steps 04-09.
An aggregator, not a parent - every module below still inherits from the root pom, so this folder changes no dependency and no artifactId. Build the group with `./mvnw test -f wealth/pom.xml`, after market and shared-kernel are installed.
The tests that cross out of this group live in vidulum-wealth-tests at the root, not here: they exercise portfolio against trading, portfolio_spec against exchange and pnl against Mongo, so they belong to no single group.
